title: ProposeResult
description: What a propose Smith writes to /work/out/result.json. The engine checks it (ReadResultDelegate) before its own rules; the Smith checks it with check-result propose. Strict types where the engine branches, any non-empty JSON where it only passes content on.

outcome.description: Branched on by the engine and the BPMN.

path.description: The doc drafted, docs/proposals/<slug>.md; the engine checks the bundle against it.

pitch.description: The pitch page drafted beside the doc, docs/proposals/<same slug>.html; the engine checks the bundle and lints the page (PitchRules).

confidence.description: Branched on: below 0.7 goes to the user in confirm mode.

impact.description: Branched on: high goes to the user in confirm mode.

options.description: The options the pitch lays out, each with a stable one-letter id; the page marks each with data-option-id and a disabled data-choose button (PitchRules), and the desktop's Pitch view picks it through POST /ticket/{owner}/{repo}/{n}/choice. Optional, since a page with nothing to choose lists none, but needed for every data-option-id the page marks: check-result propose lints the page against it.

content.description: Passed on to a brief or a GitHub comment, never branched on: any non-empty JSON. A string is shown as itself; an object or array as a fenced JSON block.
